## What's new

Threadnote 5.3.0-beta.9 makes future updates more resilient by letting a verified release candidate refresh its own workflow data through a versioned protocol.

### More compatible workflow updates

When an update changes how Threadnote stores development-workflow refresh data, the verified candidate now owns that refresh. This keeps future updater and workflow-schema changes from requiring an older installed version to understand new internal data.

Normal upgrades from 5.2.1 and from 5.3.0-beta.8 continue to work with:

```sh
threadnote update --beta
```

5.3.0-beta.7 used an earlier, strict manifest format that cannot read the newer native workflow requirements. It needs a one-time upgrade with the official bootstrap installer before later beta updates:

```sh
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/threadnote/threadnote/main/scripts/install.sh | sh -s -- --beta
threadnote update --beta
```

The bootstrap verifies the release before installing it and preserves your existing workflow ownership and personal-edit checks. Run the second command once to refresh enrolled workflows through the new protocol.
